task: ADR-034 (PMBOK Tooling Decommissioning and Lightweight LearningStore Convergence): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Decommissions shadow SQLite/FastAPI/Typer/OCR stack in favor of LearningStore (ADR-002 Invariant #2, Zero Entity Sprawl); converges PMBOK lifecycle state onto Episode records with cross-references to authoritative governance episodes under agent-learning-governance; enforces Inversion of Control with a pure domain package agent_learning.pmbok (zero storage imports, zero network I/O, zero time.sleep); unifies CLI entry point under agent-learn pmbok with batch review unrolling per-plan accountability (ADR-013 §4.2); implements auditable approval verification with latest-wins ordering (created_at, sequence_number), human-accepted disposition checks (decision_disposition: accepted), and recursive transitive DAG staleness validation across full_plan, staged pmp_section, and not_applicable nodes; aligns with ADR-012 §4.2.1 fail-closed frontmatter grammar law (Tier A Technical Integrity Hard Block); enforces audit-data minimalism (Invariant 6).

Five real alternatives named and rejected with explicit rationales: adding heavy packages to base dependencies, optional extras, stdlib sqlite3 rewrite, removing PMBOK orchestration entirely, and declaring pyyaml runtime dependency.

Honest disclosure of positive benefits (zero entity sprawl, permanent resolution of LL-013, 100% clean test collection, lightweight embeddable library) against negative trade-offs (permanent decommissioning of embedded FastAPI server and OCR ingestion, four-phase refactoring burden for Epic 12, parser maintenance overhead in agent_learning.pmbok).

Implementation specifics and scope cleanly bounded: legacy 49-process registry explicitly designated as 6th-edition process bridge mapped to ADR-012 legacy_process; PMBOK 8 40-process model scoped as future enhancement; concrete four-phase implementation sequencing with auditable completion criteria; explicit derivation logic for all seven plan lifecycle states.
